title: Read as You See: Guiding Unimodal LLMs for Low-Resource Explainable Harmful Meme Detection
benchmark_measurement: Detection of hateful and offensive content, including harmful stereotypes and negative contextual associations, targeting religious groups such as Muslims and Jews.
findings: The proposed U-CoT+ framework, which guides unimodal LLMs with human-crafted rules, effectively detects harmful memes targeting religious groups. It successfully identifies implicit hate speech, such as anti-Semitic content making light of the Holocaust and stereotypes associating Muslims with terrorism, by leveraging contextual and historical knowledge provided in the guidelines.
